title: Harden OpenAI and Codex search production gate
description: Audit and verify src/openai.ts against current OpenAI Responses and Codex contracts. Cover model/auth selection, SSE completion, citations/source normalization, hard constraints, cancellation/timeouts, error/request IDs, usage/rate limits, output trust, and credential-gated live smoke for both providers. Do not add fallback or synthesis. Done when deterministic fixtures and explicit live evidence pass and docs record provider limitations.

logs.msg: Audited OpenAI/Codex adapter against current Responses evidence contracts. Added response metadata propagation for malformed/incomplete/stream failures, classifies broken success streams as retryable network failures, maps stream aborts to canceled errors, and added rate-limit/metadata regression fixtures. 20 OpenAI tests and typecheck pass. Fresh Pi Codex live smoke already passed; direct OpenAI smoke remains skipped because dedicated API credentials are absent.
